recentItems.description:

#Emergency247 #Hospital #NHS #Documentary  

Emergency 24/7: Embedded inside the busy Southmead Hospital, a Major Trauma Centre in Bristol, this series reveals the everyday pressures, and complex teamwork, required to keep the Emergency Department running.
